comment: The Reset and Run outputs (indices 30 and 31) are described from the maker's release notes, which say the editor's Run and Reset buttons have matching outputs on the panel for driving your clock. Whether Run is a gate or a trigger is not stated anywhere and was not settled, so neither jack is given a family. The End of phrase output on Drummer and Melody, and End of clip on Timeline, are named in the release notes and nowhere else; End of clip is left untagged because which track's clip it follows is not stated. The panel menu also carries Stop recording at end of song and Automatically add repeat markers when recording, which are recording options a play-only module cannot use, and Light theme and Dark theme, which are cosmetic. None of those gets a line.
